mentions.name: 2cents.club
mentions.description: A simple website for earning cashback on travel purchases (with retail coming soon). It links users to Booking.com and Expedia, uses a no-registration-required flow to reduce signup friction, and supports withdrawals via bank account or crypto wallet.
mentions.problem: Forced sign-up registration was a friction point slowing users from reaching their travel booking links, so the service moved to a no-registration flow.
mentions.audience: A consumer cashback service for people booking travel (and soon shopping retail), aimed at getting shoppers to their travel links quickly.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on https://2cents.club/ - it's a simple site to get cashback on travel (and soon retail).
